visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two young women sit on a wooden bench at a modern public transport station; the woman on the left wears a denim shirt over a white top and grey cardigan, laughing, while the woman on the right wears a white t-shirt with a black sweater over her shoulders, looking contemplative. (2) The scene shifts to the two women walking side-by-side in a sun-drenched urban square, holding hands briefly as they move past a large concrete pillar. (3) A sequence of mirror selfies follows where one woman holds a professional DSLR camera, posing with a peace sign and a wink in a well-lit indoor room with a large mirror. (4) A young toddler boy with short hair appears indoors, enthusiastically unboxing a dark blue shoe box on a green crate while wearing a small crossbody bag. (5) Back outdoors, the two women are seen walking across a pedestrian crosswalk; a close-up focuses on their black leather loafers and white socks stepping on the white stripes. (6) The women are then shown interacting with a white vending machine, laughing and holding a can of beverage as the sun sets behind urban buildings. (7) Final scenes show the women together on the bench again, holding a large black leather tote bag and making heart gestures with their hands, followed by the toddler walking towards the camera in a stylish outfit.
